meta.title: Zotero Sync
meta.description: Uploads the documents this conversation produced — Markdown notes, PDFs, Office files — into your local Zotero library, and reads your library back: search items, inspect metadata, extract PDF full text, resolve attachment paths, and export BibTeX/RIS. Talks to Zotero's built-in local server on 127.0.0.1:23119 — no API key and nothing to install inside Zotero. Upload rows sit beside each turn's deliverables plus a composer chip; the /zotero command and the zotero_sync / zotero_library tools cover everything. Unchanged files are skipped instead of duplicated.
